title: Weekly Updates #2
imageCaption: Who's going to be the Season Champion?
intro: Another packed week. The game rebranded, grew accounts and friends, and got a full visual overhaul. Here's everything that changed:

sections.heading: New stuff
items: We're now Rinne, with our own domain at playrinne.com.
Player accounts: profiles, friends, seasons, global stats, and account security.
Async PvP: challenge a friend offline.
Elite Four flow, a Safari Zone roster, and a Hall of Fame scene for champions.
Profile banners with a live preview and shareable card.
Pokemon art switched to pixel sprites, with Team/Storage and Safari Zone redesigned around them.
A canvas-based evolution animation popup and a redesigned gym-win badge popup.
Per-battle-type backgrounds, plus new gym leader backgrounds.

sections.heading: Balance
items: Nuzlocke's catch rate, ball flee chance, Potion healing, casino access, and shop prices are now equalized with the other modes.
Legendary and Mythical encounters are single-Pokemon now, no bench.
Switching costs a turn in PvP, and the Alola/Galar bonus pool got wider.
Expanded trainer rank titles and raised the Champion Class requirements.
Removed per-battle item and switch caps, and added the Paralyze status.

sections.heading: Bug fixes
items: Fixed Continue Run showing the wrong save after signing in, and staying resumable after the run had already ended.
Fixed Shedinja's Wonder Guard.
Fixed orphaned Zygarde/Pyroar Mega forms and the Galarian Mr. Mime name.

sections.heading: Interface
items: Redesigned the homepage sign-in flow, and matched Token Shop pricing with PokeStop.
Added a table of contents to the FAQ.
Added confirmation prompts before removing a friend or erasing a run in progress.

title: Weekly Updates #1
intro: It's been a few intense days of work! Here's a rundown of everything that changed in the game:

sections.heading: New stuff
items: We now have 18 Gym Leaders, with teams drawn by strength tier and their own dedicated pools per type (including the return of a Fairy-only gym).
18 new Gym Leader sprites.
Overhauled Legendary/Mythical capture, Mega Evolution, and Absol's "sense" (special ability).
Fishing Bait and a reworked achievements system.
Created an official Discord server to keep the community updated.

sections.heading: Balance
items: Nuzlocke is fairer now: more voluntary swaps per battle, adjusted catch rates, Potions heal full HP.
Overall difficulty smoothed out for newer players, with a less absurd endgame.
Gym Leader teams and trade offers now scale better with player strength.
Battle AI got smarter: it weighs expected damage and type effectiveness.
Wild encounter reroll limited to 1 use per encounter.

sections.heading: Bug fixes
items: Mega Evolution with form choice (Charizard, Mewtwo, Raichu X/Y) wasn't working, fixed.
Fixed a post-Rival encounter loop and several checkpoint bugs.
Fixed Mega Tackle, implemented real Counter/Mirror Coat.
Fixed the Fishing button getting stuck after buying more bait.
Leaderboard names are now properly validated and escaped.

sections.heading: Interface
items: Back button on the trade screen, simplified trade screens.
Reorganized and expanded the FAQ (new battle system section, AI-generated art disclosure, tables reordered).
Favicon, meta description, and accessibility tweaks (focus states).
